paragraphs: The day revolves around inspection, review, and negotiation. Field visits gather photos and evidence, while evenings bring system reports. Customers ask for updates, repair shops await estimates, and managers monitor closure rates. Complex cases require surveillance footage, witness interviews, and maintenance records. Overtime is common when monthly closure targets approach.

Insurance, law, or finance provides a strong academic foundation. Complete an internship at an insurer and learn the auto and commercial claims process. Strong English can open paths into reinsurance and international insurers.
